refund_policy: Evaluation fees are treated as subscription fees; an optional paid 'Refund on First Payout' add-on is offered at checkout on QT TWO, Instant and BNPL plans. No general refund policy captured.
activation_fee: BNPL 1-Step only: $65 / $100 / $180 / $325 / $650 for $5K / $10K / $25K / $50K / $100K, payable within 7 calendar days of passing
scaling_plan: About page says splits can reach 90% via a Scaling Plan; no scaling-plan terms published in the help centre
ea_bots: EA use is a checkout add-on ('Usage of EA'); HFT, tick scalping, latency/arbitrage and server-flooding algorithms prohibited
max_risk_per_trade: Evaluation: total exposure must stay below 75% of the daily drawdown limit; funded: max 1% floating loss (QT ONE/QT TWO), 1% per instrument (Instant), 2% (BNPL); stop loss within 60 s required on QT TWO and Instant funded
inactivity_rule: No closed trade within 7 days (QT ONE) or 14 days (QT TWO, Instant, Power, BNPL) → hard breach; counted from purchase if no trades
notes: Minimum payout = 1% of account or $100, whichever is higher (5% on Instant). Payout processing within 24 business hours; risk interviews may be required and missing one forfeits the payout. KYC (Didit) must be completed before funded activation. Reverse/group hedging across accounts prohibited; same-account hedging not addressed. Commission $4 per round lot. Other add-ons: variable spreads, swap-free, +10% split (80→90%), 7-day payout. Reset fee not published.
